source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 13 (PDF 4-17), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermal Physics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is Brownian motion? Explain its cause and the factors on which its speed depends. Also state the basic assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases. (5 marks)
(Brownian motion kya hai? Is ki wajah aur un awamil ki wazahat karein jin par is ki speed munhasir hai. Kinetic theory of gases ke bunyadi mafrooze bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Brownian motion: fluid mein lataktay chhote zarraat ki be-tarteeb (zig-zag) harkat jo fluid ke molecules ki takkar se hoti hai. 1827 mein botanist Robert Brown ne microscope se liquid mein pollen zarraat ko be-tarteeb ghoomte dekha. Einstein ne 1905 mein wazahat ki aur J Perrin ne 1908 mein tajurbe se tasdeeq ki.

Wajah: har takkar ke baad molecule ka raasta badalta hai. Har takkar momentum aur energy ka tabadla karti hai, is liye baar baar takrane wala zarra zig-zag raasta banata hai (Fig. 13.1). Yeh randomness ka saada model hai.

Awamil:
(1) Mass/size: momentum ki muntaqili mass ke ulat mutanasib hai, is liye halke zarraat zyada speed paate hain.
(2) Viscosity: zarraat ki speed fluid ki viscosity (andaruni ragar) ke ulat mutanasib hai; kam viscosity par harkat tez.

Kinetic theory ke mafrooze:
(1) Gas bohat se nanhay gol zarraat par mushtamil hai jo apne size ke muqable mein door hain; un ka apna volume na-qabil-e-zikr.
(2) Zarraat musalsal tez aur be-tarteeb harkat mein hain.
(3) Zarraat aur deewaron ki takkarein bilkul elastic hain.
(4) Takkar ke ilawa zarraat mein na kashish hai na dafa.
(5) Zarraat ki average kinetic energy temperature par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: There are various reasons and causes of this motion which are given as under:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne Brownian motion ko 'gas ke molecules ki harkat' kaha aur saal 1927 likha; sahih yeh hai ke yeh fluid mein lataktay zarraat ki harkat hai aur saal 1827 hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
2 A cylinder of volume 0.025 m³ contains an ideal gas at a pressure of 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa and a temperature of 350 K. Find (i) the number of gas molecules and (ii) the number of moles. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹, N_A = 6.02 × 10²³) (3 marks)
(0.025 m³ ke cylinder mein ideal gas 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa pressure aur 350 K par hai. (i) gas molecules ki tadaad aur (ii) moles ki tadaad nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹, N_A = 6.02 × 10²³))
blocks.explanation: Molecules ke liye PV = Nk_BT, phir n = N/N_A.

book_ref.quote: The number of moles in terms of number of particle N is defined as; n = N/N_A, then

blocks.prompt:
3 A single molecule of mass m moves with velocity component vₓ inside a cubical box of side L. Using the kinetic theory, obtain expressions for (i) its change in momentum on striking a wall, (ii) the time between its successive collisions with the same wall, (iii) the average force on the wall and (iv) the pressure it exerts. (5 marks)
(m mass ka aik molecule L side ke cube mein vₓ velocity component se chal raha hai. Kinetic theory se (i) deewar se takrane par momentum ki tabdeeli, (ii) aik hi deewar se lagataar takkaron ka waqt, (iii) deewar par average force aur (iv) us ka pressure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Model: m mass ka aik molecule L side ke cube mein aage peeche chalta hai (Fig. 13.2) aur deewaron se elastic takkar khata hai.

(i) Momentum ki tabdeeli: x-axis par deewar se mvₓ momentum se takrata aur −mvₓ se lautta hai.
Δp = −mvₓ − (mvₓ) = −2mvₓ

(ii) Takkaron ka waqt: aik hi deewar se lagataar takkaron ke darmiyan 2L faasla.
Δt = 2L/vₓ ... (13.3)

(iii) Force: Newton ke doosre qanoon se force = momentum ki tabdeeli ki sharah. Newton ke teesre qanoon se molecule ki deewar par force ulti simt mein hai, is liye miqdaar lete hain:
F = |Δp|/Δt = 2mvₓ/(2L/vₓ) = mvₓ²/L ... (13.4)

(iv) Pressure: deewar ka area L².
P = F/L² = mvₓ²/L³
P = mvₓ²/V ... (13.5)
jahan V = L³ dabbe ka volume hai. Yeh aik molecule ka deewar par pressure hai.

book_ref.quote: It is assumed that a single molecule is moving in a cube-like box of each side L

blocks.prompt:
4 An oxygen molecule of mass 5.3 × 10⁻²⁶ kg moves with vₓ = 450 m s⁻¹ inside a cubical box of side 0.10 m. Find (i) the magnitude of its change in momentum at one wall, (ii) the time between its collisions with that wall, (iii) the average force and (iv) the pressure it exerts on the wall. (3 marks)
(5.3 × 10⁻²⁶ kg ka oxygen molecule 0.10 m side ke cube mein vₓ = 450 m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. (i) aik deewar par momentum ki tabdeeli, (ii) us deewar se takkaron ka waqt, (iii) average force aur (iv) deewar par pressure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: |Δp| = 2mvₓ, Δt = 2L/vₓ, F = |Δp|/Δt aur P = F/L² istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: As pressure is force per unit area, exerted on walls of the container

blocks.prompt:
5 Starting from the pressure of one molecule, P = mvₓ²/V, obtain the kinetic-theory expression PV = ⅓Nm<v²> for N molecules. Explain why the mean square velocity is used, and express the result in terms of the density of the gas. (5 marks)
(Aik molecule ke pressure P = mvₓ²/V se shuru kar ke N molecules ke liye PV = ⅓Nm<v²> hasil karein. Wazahat karein ke mean square velocity kyun li jati hai, aur nateeja gas ki density ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tamam molecules: deewar se takrane wale tamam molecules ka hissa jama karein, har aik ki speed mukhtalif:
P = (m/V)(v₁ₓ² + v₂ₓ² + v₃ₓ² + ...) ... (13.6)

Squares kyun: molecule vₓ se takrata aur −vₓ se lautta hai, saada average sifar aata hai. Is sifar se bachne ke liye average se pehle square karte hain:
<vₓ²> = (v₁ₓ² + v₂ₓ² + ... + v_Nₓ²)/N
is liye v₁ₓ² + v₂ₓ² + ... = N<vₓ²>, aur P = (Nm/V)<vₓ²>.
Average square ka square root rms velocity hai: (vᵣₘₛ)ₓ = √<vₓ²>.

Teen simtein: molecules teeno simton mein yaksaan average speed se chalte hain:
<v²> = <vₓ²> + <v_y²> + <v_z²> = 3<vₓ²> ... (13.10)
<vₓ²> = <v²>/3 ... (13.11)

Nateeja:
P = (N/3V)m<v²> ... (13.12)
PV = ⅓Nm<v²> ... (13.13)

Density ki shakal mein: kul mass M = mN, is liye ρ = mN/V. Phir
P = ⅓ρ<v²>
Gas ka pressure us ki density aur molecules ki mean square speed par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The total force, we must add up the contributions of all the molecules that strike the wall

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein Eq. (13.8) aur (13.14) ghalat chhapi hain. Sahih: rms = √<v²> (pehle squares ka average, phir root) aur P = ⅓ρ<v²> (PV nahi, kyun ke ρ mein V pehle se shamil hai) (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
6 An ideal gas has a density of 2.4 kg m⁻³ at a pressure of 1.6 × 10⁵ Pa. Find (i) the mean square speed and (ii) the rms speed of its molecules. (3 marks)
(Aik ideal gas ki density 2.4 kg m⁻³ aur pressure 1.6 × 10⁵ Pa hai. Molecules ki (i) mean square speed aur (ii) rms speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: P = ⅓ρ<v²> se <v²> nikalein, phir square root lein.

book_ref.quote: This is the pressure of the gas which depends on the density and root mean square of velocity.

blocks.prompt:
7 Show that the pressure of a gas is two-thirds of the average translational kinetic energy of its molecules per unit volume, i.e. P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>. What do N₀ and <K.E._T> stand for? (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke gas ka pressure fi unit volume molecules ki average translational K.E. ka do tihai hai, yani P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>. N₀ aur <K.E._T> kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory ke nateeje se shuru karein:
PV = ⅓Nm<v²> ... (13.13)
P = (mN/3V)<v²>

⅓m<v²> ko ⅔ × ½m<v²> likhein:
P = ⅔(N/V)<½mv²>

N₀ = N/V, yani fi unit volume molecules ki tadaad:
P = ⅔N₀<½mv²>

<½mv²> = <K.E._T> aik molecule ki average translational kinetic energy hai, is liye
P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>

Matlab: N₀<K.E._T> fi unit volume kul translational K.E. hai; pressure is ka do tihai hai. Fi unit volume molecules ya un ki average K.E. (temperature) barhe to pressure barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Rearranging the pressure, Eq. (13.13) for P, and substituting the density

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Section 13.4 mein P = ⅔<K.E._T> chhapa hai jis mein N₀ ghayab hai; sahih P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T> hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
8 A gas contains 3.0 × 10²⁵ molecules per cubic metre, and the average translational kinetic energy of a molecule is 5.0 × 10⁻²¹ J. Find (i) the pressure of the gas and (ii) its temperature. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Aik gas mein fi m³ 3.0 × 10²⁵ molecules hain aur aik molecule ki average translational K.E. 5.0 × 10⁻²¹ J hai. (i) gas ka pressure aur (ii) temperature nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Pressure ke liye P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T> aur temperature ke liye <K.E._T> = (3/2)k_BT.

book_ref.quote: This force spreads over whole wall area of the container.

blocks.prompt:
9 By equating the gas law with the kinetic-theory expression for pressure, derive the formula for the rms speed of gas molecules, vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A). How does the rms speed depend on temperature and on the mass of one mole? (5 marks)
(Gas law aur pressure ke kinetic-theory formula ko barabar kar ke gas molecules ki rms speed vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A) ka formula nikalein. rms speed temperature aur aik mole ke mass par kaise munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation:
PV ke do formulas:
Gas law: PV = nRT
Kinetic theory: PV = (N/3)m<v²> = (N/3)mvᵣₘₛ²

Barabar karne se:
nRT = (N/3)mvᵣₘₛ² ... (13.15)
mvᵣₘₛ² = 3nRT/N

N/n = N_A aik mole mein molecules ki tadaad (Avogadro's number) hai, is liye n/N = 1/N_A:
mvᵣₘₛ² = 3RT/N_A
ya ½mvᵣₘₛ² = 3RT/2N_A
ya vᵣₘₛ² = 3RT/(mN_A)
vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A) ... (13.16)

Yahan mN_A gas ke aik mole ka mass hai.

Inhesaar:
(1) vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T: absolute temperature barhane se rms speed barhti hai (chaar guna T par do guna speed).
(2) vᵣₘₛ ∝ 1/√(mN_A): aik hi temperature par bhaari mole wali gas ke molecules aahista chalte hain.
k_B = R/N_A se yahi nateeja vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m) hai.

book_ref.quote: We have calculated the pressure of the gas molecule with n (=N/V) molecules

blocks.prompt:
10 The mass of one mole of oxygen is 0.032 kg. Find (i) the rms speed of oxygen molecules at 350 K and (ii) the temperature at which this rms speed would be doubled. (R = 8.31 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Oxygen ke aik mole ka mass 0.032 kg hai. (i) 350 K par oxygen molecules ki rms speed aur (ii) woh temperature nikalein jis par yeh rms speed dugni ho jaye. (R = 8.31 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A) lagayein; vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T, is liye speed dugni karne ke liye absolute temperature chaar guna.

book_ref.quote: However, M/m is simply Avogadro's number

steps: vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T, is liye 2vᵣₘₛ ke liye T' = 4T = 1400 K

blocks.prompt:
11 Using the rms-speed relation and k_B = R/N_A, obtain the expression <K.E._T> = (3/2)k_BT for the average translational kinetic energy of a gas molecule. Find the value of k_BT at 300 K in joules and in electron volts, and explain why the electron volt is used. (5 marks)
(rms-speed ke taalluq aur k_B = R/N_A se gas molecule ki average translational K.E. ka formula <K.E._T> = (3/2)k_BT hasil karein. 300 K par k_BT ki qeemat joules aur electron volts mein nikalein, aur batayein electron volt kyun istemal hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory aur gas law se (topic 13.4):
mvᵣₘₛ² = 3RT/N_A
Gas constant aur Boltzmann constant ka taalluq k_B = R/N_A, is liye
mvᵣₘₛ² = 3k_BT
½m<v²> = (3/2)k_BT ... (13.17)

½mvᵣₘₛ² molecule ki average translational kinetic energy <K.E._T> hai. Yani
⅔(½mvᵣₘₛ²) = k_BT ... (13.18)
<K.E._T> = (3/2)k_BT

Matlab: average translational K.E. absolute temperature ka aik constant guna hai, is liye gas ka temperature molecules ki average translational K.E. ka seedha paimana hai.

300 K par qeemat:
k_BT = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ × 300 = 4.14 × 10⁻²¹ J
k_B = 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹ se: k_BT = 0.026 eV

Electron volt: aisi energies joules mein bohat chhoti hain, is liye electron volt istemal hota hai. 1 eV us electron ki K.E. hai jo aik volt ke potential farq se accelerate ho; 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.

book_ref.quote: The average translational kinetic energy of the molecules in a gas is given by

blocks.prompt:
12 Find (i) the average translational kinetic energy of a gas molecule at 600 K in joules and in electron volts, and (ii) the temperature at which this average energy is 6.21 × 10⁻²¹ J. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J) (3 marks)
(Gas molecule ki (i) 600 K par average translational K.E. joules aur electron volts mein, aur (ii) woh temperature jis par yeh energy 6.21 × 10⁻²¹ J ho, nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J))
blocks.explanation: <K.E._T> = (3/2)k_BT lagayein, joules ko 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ se taqseem kar ke eV banayein, aur T ke liye formula ulat dein.

book_ref.quote: For an air molecule at room temperature (300 K), the quantity k_BT is

blocks.prompt:
13 What is statistical physics? Write the Boltzmann distribution law, explain each symbol in it, and state what it tells us about the populations of energy states. Also state the average kinetic energy of a molecule at temperature T. (5 marks)
(Statistical physics kya hai? Boltzmann distribution law likhein, har symbol ki wazahat karein, aur batayein ke yeh energy states ki aabadi ke baare mein kya batata hai. Temperature T par molecule ki average K.E. bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Statistical physics: bohat se molecules ke liye statistical physics istemal hoti hai, physics ki woh shaakh jo probability theory (imkaan ka nazariya) istemal karti hai. System ke atoms aur molecules mukhtalif speeds ki wajah se mukhtalif energy states E₁, E₂, E₃, ... mein ho sakte hain.

Pas-e-manzar: 1860 mein James Clerk Maxwell ne thermal equilibrium par molecular speeds ki taqseem ka formula nikala, jis ki tasdeeq taqreeban 60 saal baad hui. Boltzmann ne Boltzmann kinetic equation nikali jo bohat se molecules wali gases ke dynamic amal bayan karti hai.

Boltzmann distribution law:
N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT) ... (13.19)
N₁, N₂ = nichli aur oonchi energy states ki aabadi
ΔE = E₂ − E₁ = states ka energy farq
k_B = Boltzmann constant, T = absolute temperature
e^(−ΔE/k_BT) = Boltzmann factor

Matlab: kisi khaas energy state mein molecules milne ka imkaan −E/k_BT ke mutabiq exponentially badalta hai. ΔE > 0 hai, is liye N₂/N₁ < 1: nichli states mein oonchi se zyada zarraat hote hain.

Average energy: molecule har second arbon takkarein khata hai aur har takkar speed aur K.E. badalti hai, magar temperature T par average K.E.
E_av = (3/2)k_BT ... (13.20)
jahan k_B dar-asal fi molecule gas constant hai.

book_ref.quote: So far we know that kinetic theory of gases is used to determine the pressure of the ideal gas

blocks.prompt:
14 Two energy levels of the molecules of a gas are separated by 0.052 eV. The gas is at 300 K and the lower level holds 1.0 × 10²⁰ molecules. Find (i) k_BT in eV, (ii) the Boltzmann factor and (iii) the number of molecules in the higher level. (k_B = 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Gas ke molecules ki do energy levels mein 0.052 eV ka farq hai. Gas 300 K par hai aur nichli level par 1.0 × 10²⁰ molecules hain. (i) k_BT eV mein, (ii) Boltzmann factor aur (iii) oonchi level par molecules ki tadaad nikalein. (k_B = 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Pehle k_BT, phir Boltzmann factor e^(−ΔE/k_BT) = N₂/N₁, aur N₁ se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: is important in describing the statistical mechanics of a large number of molecules

blocks.final_answer: k_BT = 0.0259 eV; Boltzmann factor ≈ 0.134; N₂ ≈ 1.3 × 10¹⁹ molecules

blocks.prompt:
15 What are neutron stars? Describe their main features, explain what pulsars are and how their radiation is produced, and explain why the magnetic field becomes very strong when a star collapses into a neutron star. (5 marks)
(Neutron stars kya hain? Un ki ahem khasoosiyat bayan karein, pulsars kya hain aur un ki radiation kaise banti hai, aur wazahat karein ke neutron star bante waqt magnetic field itni taqatwar kyun ho jati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Neutron stars: ghane baqiyat jo tab bante hain jab sooraj se taqreeban das guna mass wale star ka iron core supernova dhamake mein gravity se collapse karta hai. Yeh kainaat ki ghani tareen ashya mein se hain, sirf black holes se peeche.

Khasoosiyat:
(1) Intehai density ki wajah se andar ka maadda degenerate gas ki tarah bartao karta hai.
(2) Taqatwar gravitational fields inhein model karna mushkil banati hain, aur qareeb tareen bhi kai parsec door hain.
(3) NASA ke andaze se Milky Way mein aik arab tak neutron stars ho sakte hain.
(4) Aik chamach maadde ka mass 5.5 × 10¹² kg se zyada; is density par poori zameen 305 m diameter ke kurre mein sama jaye.

Pulsars: kai neutron stars nisbatan jawan hain, tez ghoomte hain aur radiation ki shuaaein chhorte hain; yeh pulsars hain. Khayal hai ke taqatwar magnetic fields maadde ko magnetic poles ki taraf le jati hain to radiation paida hoti hai.

Taqatwar magnetic field: star ke collapse mein mass ke saath magnetic field bhi dab jati hai. Core ke sukarne par field lines qareeb aa jati hain, aur qareeb lines ka matlab taqatwar field hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to their extremely high density, matter inside neutron stars behaves like a degenerate gas

blocks.prompt:
16 A massive star has mass 3 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 6 × 10⁸ m and internal pressure 1.0 × 10¹⁵ Pa. Using P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴, find its gravitational pressure and decide whether the star is stable. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²) (3 marks)
(Aik bhaari star ka mass 3 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 6 × 10⁸ m aur andaruni pressure 1.0 × 10¹⁵ Pa hai. P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴ se gravitational pressure nikalein aur batayein ke star stable hai ya nahi. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²))
blocks.explanation: P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴ nikal kar andaruni pressure se muqabla karein; jo bara ho woh sukarne ya phailne ka faisla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Calculate gravitational pressure and compare it with internal pressure

steps: P_g/P_internal ≈ 4.6, gravity zyada taqatwar: star stable nahi, sukrega (neutron star ya black hole ban sakta hai)
blocks.final_answer: P_g ≈ 4.6 × 10¹⁵ Pa > 1.0 × 10¹⁵ Pa: star sukrega (stable nahi)

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the formation of the Sun and the stages of its life cycle. In which stage is it now, and why is the Sun important in thermal physics? (5 marks)
(Sooraj ke banne aur us ke life cycle ke marahil bayan karein. Woh is waqt kis marhale mein hai, aur thermal physics mein sooraj kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Sooraj zameen ka qareeb tareen star aur hamare liye heat aur roshni ka bara zariya hai.

Banna: taqreeban 4.6 arab saal pehle sooraj gas aur gard ke bare baadal solar nebula se bana. Gravitational sukar se markaz ka temperature barha aur protostar bana. Core bohat garam hua to nuclear fusion shuru hua, hydrogen helium mein badli aur bohat energy nikli.

Life ke marahil (Fig. 13.5):
nebula → protostar → main sequence → red giant → planetary nebula → white dwarf

Mojooda marhala: sooraj main sequence mein hai aur hydrogen ko helium mein badal kar heat aur roshni bana raha hai.

Istehkaam: jab tak andar ki taraf gravitational pressure (P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴) aur andaruni pressure barabar hon, star equilibrium mein rehta hai. Gravity zyada ho to star sukarta hai; andaruni pressure zyada ho to phailta hai aur red giant ban sakta hai.

Thermal physics mein ahmiyat: sooraj bohat bari heat energy ka qudrati zariya hai aur yeh energy zyada tar radiation se muntaqil karta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the core became extremely hot, nuclear fusion started

blocks.prompt:
18 A star has mass 2 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 1 × 10⁹ m and internal pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa. Using P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴, find its gravitational pressure and state what will happen to the star. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²) (3 marks)
(Aik star ka mass 2 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 1 × 10⁹ m aur andaruni pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴ se gravitational pressure nikalein aur batayein star ka kya hoga. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²))
blocks.explanation: P_g nikal kar andaruni pressure se muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: A star has mass 1 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 1 × 10⁹ m and internal pressure 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa.

steps: P_internal/P_g ≈ 1.9, andaruni pressure ghalib: star phailega aur red giant ban sakta hai
blocks.final_answer: P_g ≈ 2.7 × 10¹⁴ Pa < 5 × 10¹⁴ Pa: star phailega (red giant ban sakta hai)

blocks.prompt:
19 How does a star form from a nebula and reach equilibrium? Write the hydrostatic equation of a star, explain every symbol in it, and explain the role of nuclear fusion in keeping the star in equilibrium. (5 marks)
(Nebula se star kaise banta aur equilibrium tak pohanchta hai? Star ki hydrostatic equation likhein, har symbol ki wazahat karein, aur equilibrium qaim rakhne mein nuclear fusion ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Banna: tamam stars gas aur gard ke baadalon (nebulae ya molecular clouds) se bante hain. Baadal sukarta hai to zarraat ki K.E. barhne se density aur temperature barhte hain (K.E. ∝ T); yeh protostar hai. Million saalon baad equilibrium par pohanch kar star banta hai. Fig. 13.4 gravity aur pressure ka muqabla dikhati hai.

Equilibrium: temperature barhne se andaruni pressure bhi barhta hai. Jab andar ki taraf gravitational force bahar ki taraf pressure se bilkul barabar ho to stable star banta hai. Hydrostatic equation:
ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r²

Symbols:
P = star ke andar pressure (fi unit area force)
ΔP/Δr = radius ke saath pressure ki tabdeeli ki sharah (markaz se bahar)
r = star ke markaz se faasla
G = gravitational constant (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)
Mᵣ = radius r ke andar band mass
ρᵣ = radius r par density
Manfi nishan: pressure bahar ki taraf kam hota hai jab ke gravity andar kheenchti hai.
Yeh equation yaqeeni banati hai ke star na gravity se collapse ho na be-had phaile. Gravity > andaruni pressure ho to star sukarta hai; gravity < andaruni pressure ho to phailta hai.

Fusion ka kirdar: core ka temperature barhne par hydrogen nuclei mil kar helium banate hain aur bohat energy nikalti hai. Yeh energy star ko zindagi ke zyada hisse mein chalati, collapse ke khilaf equilibrium qaim rakhti, aur andaruni temperature aahista barhati hai, is liye star phailne lagta hai.

book_ref.quote: As the temperature increases, the internal pressure also rises.

blocks.prompt:
20 At a distance r = 5 × 10⁸ m from the centre of a star, the mass enclosed is 1.0 × 10³⁰ kg and the density is 1.4 × 10³ kg m⁻³. Using the hydrostatic equation, find (i) the rate of change of pressure with radius at this point and (ii) the approximate drop in pressure over the next 1000 m outward. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²) (3 marks)
(Star ke markaz se r = 5 × 10⁸ m par andar band mass 1.0 × 10³⁰ kg aur density 1.4 × 10³ kg m⁻³ hai. Hydrostatic equation se (i) is jagah radius ke saath pressure ki tabdeeli ki sharah aur (ii) agle 1000 m bahar tak pressure mein taqreebi kami nikalein. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²))
blocks.explanation: ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r² mein qeematein rakhein, phir Δr = 1000 m se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: ΔP/Δr is the rate of change of pressure with radius

blocks.final_answer: ΔP/Δr ≈ −3.7 × 10⁵ Pa m⁻¹; 1000 m mein pressure taqreeban 3.7 × 10⁸ Pa kam

blocks.prompt:
21 Describe the later stages in the life of stars: the red giant stage, fusion of heavier elements, and the different ends of low or intermediate mass stars, very massive stars and red dwarfs. (5 marks)
(Stars ki zindagi ke baad wale marahil bayan karein: red giant marhala, bhaari elements ka fusion, aur kam/darmiyane mass, bohat bhaari aur red dwarf stars ke mukhtalif anjaam.)
blocks.explanation:
Red giant: temperature mazeed barhne aur core ki banawat badalne se star phail kar red giant ban sakta hai. Kam az kam aadhe sooraj jitne mass wale stars core mein helium fusion shuru kar ke carbon aur oxygen jaise bhaari elements banate hain. Zyada bhaari stars mein fusion marhala-war iron tak jaari rehta hai.

Aakhri anjaam zyada tar mass par munhasir hai. Nuclear fuel khatam hone par star gravitational collapse ka muqabla nahi kar sakta.

(1) Kam aur darmiyane mass wale stars: core sukar kar ghana white dwarf banta hai aur bahar ki tehein khala mein phenk di jati hain (planetary nebula).
(2) Sooraj se taqreeban das guna mass wale stars: red supergiant ke baad zabardast supernova dhamaka; be-amal iron core gravity se collapse ho kar neutron star ya black hole banta hai.
(3) Red dwarfs: kam mass aur kifayati fuel ki wajah se bohat aahista irtiqa; kainaat abhi itni purani nahi ke koi red dwarf apni zindagi mukammal kar chuka ho. Models ke mutabiq woh garam aur roshan ho kar aakhir kam mass wale white dwarf banenge.

Umrein chand million se kharbon saal tak: sab se kam mass wale stars (red dwarfs) sab se lamba jeete hain, sab se bhaari sirf chand million saal.

book_ref.quote: With further increases in temperature and changes in core composition

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki do ghaltiyan durust ki gayi hain: (1) sab se bhaari nahi, sab se halke stars sab se lamba jeete hain; (2) Fig. 13.5 mein red supergiant ke baad 'Positron' nahi, supernova hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
22 A supernova remnant is observed at a distance of 2.5 parsec. Express this distance (i) in light years and (ii) in kilometres. (1 parsec ≈ 3.26 light years ≈ 31 trillion km) (3 marks)
(Aik supernova ka baqiya 2.5 parsec ke faasle par dekha gaya. Yeh faasla (i) light years aur (ii) kilometres mein likhein. (1 parsec ≈ 3.26 light years ≈ 31 trillion km))
blocks.explanation: Parsec wale faasle ko har conversion factor se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: one parsec is approximately 3.26 light years

steps: Light years mein faasla = 2.5 × 3.26 = 8.15 light years
